verdict.rationale: Undermind's enterprise tier documents its own programmatic API and batch processing for high-volume work, and the GSK case study confirms a programmatic API integration. These are product-side ways to run research without the interactive UI. However, there is no documented headless or CI workflow, the API appears to be enterprise-only and custom, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec. MCP use through CLI agents depends on the host client, so it is not credited here. missing for 10: documented headless/CI usage, public self-serve API docs or spec, auth/token guidance for unattended runs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
